selection: Previous validation year MAE only; smaller alpha breaks ties. Reuse frozen selected model and settings. No test-based reselection.
limitations: All evaluation periods have previously been inspected; this is retrospective model development, not a fresh holdout.
Reuse identical eligible stock-month rows and label availability boundaries.
Corporate-action exclusions cause selection bias; raw price returns exclude dividends.
Model and blend selection share the validation year and can overfit it.
